themes.name: Agentic AI in research
themes.description: Focuses on AI agents that can autonomously conduct research tasks, analyze data, and generate insights, often mimicking human research workflows.

themes.name: AI coding assistants
themes.description: Covers AI tools and models designed to help researchers and developers write, debug, and optimize code.

themes.name: AI research tools
themes.description: Encompasses a broad range of AI-powered platforms, software, and utilities designed to assist in various stages of research, from data collection to analysis.

themes.name: AI usability testing
themes.description: Explores AI applications in automating and enhancing usability testing processes, including test generation and analysis.

themes.name: AI sentiment feedback
themes.description: Covers the use of AI to analyze and understand user sentiment from various feedback sources, such as reviews, surveys, and social media.

themes.name: AI testing automation
themes.description: Focuses on AI's role in automating testing processes across software development, cybersecurity, and product quality assurance.

themes.name: AI product research
themes.description: Details how AI is applied to understand market needs, identify product opportunities, and inform product development strategies.

themes.name: Synthetic users
themes.description: Investigates the creation and use of AI-generated user personas or simulated users for testing and research purposes.

themes.name: AI workforce impact
themes.description: Examines how AI is affecting jobs, skills, hiring, and the overall structure of the workforce.

themes.name: AI summarization
themes.description: Covers AI tools and techniques that condense large amounts of text or data into concise summaries.

note: Themes identified by analyzing articles from curated sources, Google News, HackerNews, and DEV.to this month.
